The '''Warlord's Palace''' was a magnificent palace on [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] in the capital city of [[Hsskhor/Legends|Hsskhor]]. The War Chief [[Raikhssa]] lived in the palace during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
